app_context: Treesh - Single-page vanilla JS / web app with dark-first glassy UI, purple accent (--treesh-purple #9328ff), Manrope typography, Lucide icons, mobile bottom sheet / desktop centered dialog.

layout_and_containers.mobile: Bottom sheet modal fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 max-h-[92dvh] rounded-t-[28px] border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[var(--surface-sheet)] overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-2xl
layout_and_containers.desktop: Centered dialog at sm:max-w-[720px] sm:rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)] backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[var(--surface-sheet)] max-h-[85vh] shadow-2xl
layout_and_containers.grab_handle: w-12 h-1.5 bg-white/20 rounded-full mx-auto my-3 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing
layout_and_containers.tabs_overflow_solution: Use custom scrollable pill-tab ribbon with snap scroll and subtle gradient fade on right mask: mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, black 85%, transparent 100%). On 390px, tabs scroll smoothly with horizontal momentum without wrapping or cutting off text.

per_person_moderation_sheet.header_strip: Compact user hero with 48px avatar, display name, handle, role chip (Member / Moderator / Admin) with distinct neon border, status chips (Suspended red pulse, Muted amber, Verified purple spark).
per_person_moderation_sheet.quick_status_banner: If banned or muted: prominent status banner at top with quick action button 'Lift Ban' or 'Unmute' with confirmation state.
per_person_moderation_sheet.tab_navigation: 5 pill tabs: 'Ban & Mute', 'Profile', 'Badges & Role', 'Reports (N)', 'Delete'. Horizontal scroll with snap-x, compact 12px 14px padding, active pill gets bg-[var(--treesh-purple)] text-white shadow-lg.
per_person_moderation_sheet.ban_and_mute_section: Segmented duration selector (1h, 1d, 3d, 1w, 30d, Permanent, Custom Date). Clear visual distinction between Ban (Danger Red tint) and Mute (Amber Tint). Reason textarea with character limit. Primary action button with inline confirm overlay ('Are you sure you want to ban @user?').
per_person_moderation_sheet.profile_section: Editable inputs for Display Name, Username, Bio. Quick actions with thumbnail previews: 'Remove Avatar' and 'Remove Banner'.
per_person_moderation_sheet.badges_and_role_section: Role cards with radio selection (Member / Moderator / Admin) featuring role permission summary. Verified toggle switch with custom icon selector dropdown.
per_person_moderation_sheet.reports_tab: List of active reports submitted against this user. Each card shows reason chip, reporter (@username or Anonymous), report details text, timestamp, and actions ('Resolve', 'Dismiss').
per_person_moderation_sheet.delete_account_tab: Admin-only red zone. Requires typing exact handle to unlock danger 'Delete Account Permanently' button.
per_person_moderation_sheet.locked_state: When non-admin views admin actions, show clean locked card with lock icon and label: 'Requires Administrator Privileges'.

moderation_dashboard.header: Gavel icon with animated glow, title 'Moderation Dashboard', status subtitle 'Logged in as Admin'. Live search input with quick filter.
moderation_dashboard.tabs: Reports (with count badge), Activity Log, Banned Users, Muted Users, Staff, Verified Users.
moderation_dashboard.reports_tab: Segmented toggle: 'Open Reports' vs 'Closed Reports'. Report cards feature reason badge with icon, reported user row with quick info, reporter details, timestamp, and primary actions ('Review Profile' -> opens per-person sheet, 'Resolve', 'Dismiss').
moderation_dashboard.activity_log: Timeline view with actor avatar, action tag, target handle, timestamp, and metadata diff.
moderation_dashboard.empty_and_loading_states: Illustrated minimal empty state with 'No pending reports - All clean!' and sleek pulsing skeleton loaders.

report_user_sheet.header: 'Report @username' with clear explanation that reports are confidential.
report_user_sheet.reasons_list: 9 selectable interactive rows with icon, bold reason name, and 1-line description: Harassment or bullying, Hate speech, Spam or scam, Inappropriate profile, Impersonation, Threats or violence, Sexual content, Underage user, Something else.
report_user_sheet.details_box: Textarea (required for 'Something else', optional otherwise) with 500 max chars counter.
report_user_sheet.submit_flow: Submit button disabled until reason selected. On submit, transitions smoothly to Success view.
report_user_sheet.success_view: Check orb pulse animation, text 'Thanks, our team will review it. @username won't know you reported them.' Direct action buttons: 'Block @username' (danger outline) and 'Done' (primary).

open_reports_badges.design: Micro pill or circular badge with pulse effect. Background var(--status-danger), text white, bold xs font. Shown on 'Open moderation' button in Settings and profile header 'Moderation' action.

motion_and_microinteractions.sheet_entrance: framer-motion / CSS slide-up spring transition (transform translateY(100%) to translateY(0%) cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1))
motion_and_microinteractions.tab_switch: layoutAnimation or subtle crossfade opacity on panel container
motion_and_microinteractions.a11y_reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables transform motions and uses instant fade

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all dialogs and bottom sheets use clean CSS variables for themes without hardcoding hex codes directly in JS except through semantic CSS variables.
Solve 390px mobile viewport horizontal clipping by wrapping tab bars in a smooth touch-scrollable container with webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch and hiding scrollbars.
Apply data-testid to every interactive component according to data_testid_mapping.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur backdrop filters on floating modals or sheets.
Ensure contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1 for all text labels in both dark and light theme.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
